description: Starkregen in Hamm is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by hamm.de. The dataset contains information about heavy rain scenarios in the Hammer urban area. The maps show three different heavy rain scenarios. A rare (index 5) rain event, an extraordinary (index 7) and an extreme rain (index 10) are considered. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain in Hamm" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Umwelt, Regen, Starkregen, ENVI, Überflutung, Risiken. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
